title: Namaste Yacht
description: Namaste is a motor yacht with a length of 42.3m. The yacht’s builder is Overmarine from Italy who delivered superyacht Namaste in 2016. The superyacht has a beam of 8.7m, a draft of 2.4m and a volume of 447 GT.
html:
Namaste is a motor yacht with a length of 42.3m. The yacht’s builder is Overmarine from Italy who delivered superyacht Namaste in 2016. The superyacht has a beam of 8.7m, a draft of 2.4m and a volume of 447 GT.

The Namaste features exterior design by Alberto Mancini Yacht Design, while her interior was penned by Alberto Mancini Yacht Design, with naval architecture by Overmarine Group SPA. Up to 12 guests are accommodated on board the superyacht Namaste, and she also has accommodation for 7 crew members including the captain of Namaste. The Mangusta Oceano 43 yacht Namaste has a steel hull and aluminium superstructure. She is powered by 2 MTU engines, which give her a cruising speed of 11.0 kn and a top speed of 15.0 kn. The yacht has a speed of 11.0 kn. The yacht carries 64,790 liters of fuel on board, and 13,840 liters of water.

On the ranking of the largest yachts in the world, Namaste superyacht is listed as number 1768th. She is the 27th-largest yacht built by Overmarine. The owner of Mangusta Oceano 43 yacht Namaste is shown in SYT iQ and is exclusively available to subscribers. On SuperYacht Times we have 20 photos of yacht Namaste, and she is featured in 7 yacht news articles. Refit market data from SYT iQ show that the yacht was last refitted in 2021.

Namaste is currently for sale at an asking price of €19,997,990 with Florida Yachts International (FYI). There are currently 1988 yachts for sale in the world. There are currently 1 Mangusta Oceano 43 yachts for sale in the world and 6 Mangusta Oceano 43 yachts in the global superyacht fleet. Motor yacht Namaste was last sold in 2019. According to data from our market intelligence system SYT iQ, she was one of the 823 yachts that were sold in 2019. The superyacht was on display at Monaco Yacht Show , Cannes Yachting Festival, Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, Miami Yacht Show, Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, Palm Beach International Boat Show. It is not known if yacht Namaste has a superyacht infotainment system by YachtEye.
